was in focus on Tuesday as StoneX started coverage on the software firm with a Buy rating and a $25 price target.

"Our investment thesis centers on Gorilla's transition from systems integration and government security solutions towards supporting customers' GPU capacity needs, better known as 'GPUaaS,'" analyst Gary Mobley wrote in a note to clients. "Across three existing contracts alone (Yotta 1, Yotta 2, and NeutraDC Batam), approximately $5.8B of potential contracted revenue exists (against a current revenue base of $100M+). If management utilizes the correct levers in this execution strategy and generates strong returns on its GPU investments, we believe there is significant upside to shareholder value."

Mobley continued: "FY27 revenue guidance of $560M is described as a "low-ball" against contracted building blocks of approximately $1.1B in annualized steady-state revenue. All three anchor programs (Yotta 1, Yotta 2, Batam) target revenue commencement to occur in Q4 2026. If they ultimately land on schedule, we believe FY27 estimates will have to move higher, whereas a slip would leave the $560M guide as a cushion. None of the longer-dated pipeline is factored into the FY27 estimate (includes Korat, Malaysia, the Middle East)."

title: Gorilla Technology in focus as StoneX starts with Buy rating
